highlights.title: The Point bar stays readable
highlights.text: Point at a part near the top of the view and its name tag now sits below or inside the outline, so "Click the part you mean" is never covered.

highlights.title: Point turns off after you send
highlights.text: Pick parts, write your message and send it: Point switches off by itself and the cursor stays in the message box. A click on a part still keeps Point on.

fixes: Clicking the same quote twice now always highlights the original message again.
Saving Computer settings is faster when Docker is slow, and Run Claude inside the VM no longer flips to unavailable after you turn it on.
After you save a backup command on Dev mode's production floor card, focus always lands on Back up first.
Focus now lands on the right field or button after you open a key field, save a setting or close a popover, even on a slow machine.
After Take back, Pause again, Remove or a cancelled sign-in, focus lands on the next button instead of getting lost when the app is busy.
